company.name: FullStory
company.shortDescription: FullStory develops a digital experience intelligence platform designed to capture customer experience data.
company.description:
FullStory is a customer experience data app that captures customer experience data in one platform. Its tiny script unlocks pixel-perfect session playback, automatic insights, funnel analytics, and robust search and segmentation empowering everyone in an organization to help build an online experience for customers.

The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.

aiResearchSummary.text: FullStory is researching methods for capturing and processing interactions with user interfaces of native applications, focusing on evaluating user sessions to understand behavior. Their work includes evaluating interactions with a user interface by identifying mutation events that specify changes to the UI structure. Additionally, they are developing tools for network latency detection by analyzing network request data from client devices. These areas reflect efforts in user interaction analysis and performance monitoring.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,012,037 to $1,800,000,000, a 299.4x increase.
